Subject: Inspection Request (Feb 1–4)
Dear Jess
My name is Yesung yoon, and I am a female Korean pharmacy student at Griffith University. I will be arriving in the Gold Coast on February 1st, and I am very interested in your property. I would like to kindly request an inspection between February 1 and 4, if that is available for you.
The room and its location seem ideal for my needs. I am looking for a clean, quiet, and comfortable space where I can focus on my studies, and your home appears to be the perfect place for that. I am a tidy and responsible person, and I always take good care of the place where I live.
Please let me know if any of those dates work for you. I truly appreciate your time and consideration, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Kind regards,
Yesung Yoon
